## NumberInput.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: The number. `null` when the field is empty. Bindable; works controlled and uncontrolled.
- `onValueChange` :: Called with the new number (or `null` when cleared) whenever it changes.
- `min` :: The inclusive lower bound. Arrow, Page, wheel and the stepper all honour it.
- `max` :: The inclusive upper bound.
- `step` :: How much Arrow Up/Down, the stepper and the wheel change the value. Page Up/Down move by ten times this.
- `precision` :: How many decimal places the value is rounded to. Omit it to keep every place `step` allows.
- `format` :: `Intl.NumberFormat` options used to present the value while the field is not being edited.
- `locale` :: Locale identifier passed to `Intl.NumberFormat`.
- `formatOptions` :: Alias for `format` options passed to `Intl.NumberFormat`.
- `scrubbable` :: Enables horizontal pointer-drag scrubbing via a leading grip handle.
- `size` :: The control height. Text follows this unless `textSize` is set. @default 'lg'
- `textSize` :: The text scale, independent of the control height. Follows `size` when omitted.
- `textColor` :: The ink of the scrub grip; muted by default so it reads as a handle rather than content.
- `shape` :: The corner shape. @default 'modern'
- `variant` :: `outline` is a bordered field, `secondary` a tinted one without a border, `ghost` is bare until hovered or focused. @default 'outline'
- `invalid` :: Marks the field invalid (red border, `aria-invalid`). Inside a `Field` it follows the field's error unless set.
- `ref` :: The underlying `<input>` element. Bindable.
- `disabled` :: Blocks pointer and keyboard input, and dims the frame.
